name: DoWhatISay (DOWIS)
description: DOWIS is a multilingual spoken prompt dataset designed to evaluate Speech Large Language Models (SLLMs) under realistic spoken instruction conditions. It pairs spoken and written prompts across multiple tasks, languages, and styles to benchmark SLLM performance on speech-based prompting.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for evaluating speech-language models on realistic multilingual spoken instructions, with limited but growing adoption.
notes: Covers 9 tasks and 11 languages with 10 prompt variants per task-language pair; highlights performance gaps between spoken and text prompts.
